integrity: The original stability-polynomial and SSP framework is credited to prior literature; the asserted contribution is a graph-specific sharp classification and precise separation from spectral stability. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Final RK4 end-step only; no claim for internal stage positivity, nonlinear problems, or nonuniform weights on complete bipartite support. Graph-family universality follows from the analytic proof; finite calculations are supplementary.
title: Exact RK4 positivity and spectral-stability separation on regular bipartite networks
